meta.core_definition: rating <= 3 (app-store, google-play) OR source == hacker-news (no rating)
meta.thin_rule: thin = fewer than 3 reviews OR only one source
meta.id_note: ids are 0-based data-row indexes of reviews.csv; urls are the stable key

ads.label: Too many ads, ads too long or too loud
ads.notes: FP: "adds" used as a verb (1111,1112), ads mentioned without complaint ("I understand ads", "I accept ads", "no ads" as a benefit of another service). FN: misspelling "advisement" (1019).

ads_while_paying.label: Paying for Premium but still getting ads or promos (podcast ads, sponsored recs, popups)
ads_while_paying.notes: Manual theme: reviewer states they pay (Premium/Family/Basic) AND complains of ads, podcast ads, sponsored recommendations or promo pop-ups. The co-occurrence keyword is a candidate generator only.

free_tier_control.label: Free tier removes control of my own playlists: skip cap, daily song-pick cap, forced shuffle/order, no repeat, no rewind
free_tier_control.notes: Must name a concrete lost control: pick a song, skip cap, forced shuffle/order, repeat/loop, rewind/seek, queue, or "can't play the songs I want". Paywalled speaker/TV/AirPlay moved to devices_connect. Generic "everything is behind Premium" moved to paywall_generic.
v2_patterns: run out of skips|out of skips|used up all my skips
limit(ed)? (number of |amount (to|of) how often you can )?skip
repeat (a|the) song|repeat songs|put a song on repeat|loop button
go back(wards)? (a little|songs|in order|or fast|and play)
try again tomorrow|wait (until|till) (tomorrow|tmr|the next day)|songs tomorrow|until the next day
daily limit|music limit|limit of songs|limit on what songs|limit to choose
can'?t play albums in order|can'?t play (in order|a playlist in order)

ftc_pick_cap.label: Free tier: daily song-pick cap / cannot play the song I want (subset)
ftc_pick_cap.notes: Sub-split of free_tier_control (hand-checked within the 88). Its keyword precision in metrics is computed over all core reviews, so it is low by design.
v1_patterns: pick|choose|chose|tomorrow|tmr|next day|limit|song i want|songs i want|premium feature
v2_patterns: pick|choose|chose|tomorrow|tmr|next day|limit|song i want|songs i want|premium feature

ftc_order_shuffle.label: Free tier: forced shuffle / no play-in-order (subset)
ftc_order_shuffle.notes: Sub-split of free_tier_control: forced shuffle / cannot play in order.

ftc_seek_rewind.label: Free tier: no seek/rewind (subset)
v1_patterns: go back|backwards|rewind|fast forward|scroll any part|skip to the part
v2_patterns: go back|backwards|rewind|fast forward|scroll any part|skip to the part

paywall_generic.label: Generic: "everything is behind Premium" / free tier is crippled
paywall_generic.notes: Generic resentment that the free tier is crippled / forces Premium, without naming a specific control. Disjoint from free_tier_control.

price.label: Too expensive / not worth the price
price.notes: TP = price too high / rising / not worth the money / can't afford. FP: "greed" aimed at paywalls, currency used as leverage for a bug complaint, audiobook top-up pricing (kept in audiobook_hours), rebuttals.
v2_patterns: is not worth it\.?$|€\d+ is not worth

price_increase.label: Price increases (subset of price)
v1_patterns: price.{0,25}(increase|hike|going up|goes up|go up|gone up|went up|up and up|keeps? going|stupid|climbing|jack)
v2_patterns: price.{0,25}(increase|hike|going up|goes up|go up|gone up|went up|up and up|keeps? going|stupid|climbing)
getting pricey|becoming too pricey|cost of spotify is getting

audiobook_hours.label: Audiobook hour cap / audiobooks not included

shuffle_not_random.label: Shuffle is not random: the same few songs repeat
shuffle_not_random.notes: Shuffle/rotation repeats the same few songs. Excludes forced shuffle on the free tier (free_tier_control).
v1_patterns: shuffl\w*.{0,200}(same|repeat|not random|isn'?t random|doesn'?t (seem )?(very )?random|stick|cycle|back to back|handful|small percentage|never play)
v2_patterns: shuffl\w*.{0,200}(same|repeats?|not random|isn'?t random|doesn'?t (seem )?(very )?random|stick|cycle|back to back|handful|small percentage|never play|laughably)
